10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.

content.text:
The user wants the pet to be a cat instead of a corgi. So I need to rework the pet SVG into a ghost cat (given gothic theme), and update all text references from corgi/Nugget to cat. Should I keep name Nugget? A cat named Nugget is fine, but maybe rename to "Salem" or "Whiskers"? The user asked "Can pet be a cat". I'll make it a spectral black cat named "Nugget" still? Hmm, "Nugget the ghost corgi" is referenced in meta description and help. Better to rename to a cat name like "Brimstone" or "Salem". But changing the name might be a bigger change; user just asked pet be a cat. I can keep "Nugget" — a black cat named Nugget is cute. But "corgi" references must go. Maybe call it "Nugget the ghost cat" — a spectral black cat. Let's do that: keep Nugget, change "corgi" to "cat" everywhere.

Need to:
1. Replace pet SVG with a cat SVG. Ghost cat: black/dark spectral cat with glowing green eyes, sitting, tail swishing, maybe translucent. Since gothic, a black cat with glowing eyes is perfect. But on dark background, a black cat may be hard to see. Use a dark charcoal-purple cat with ectoplasm rim light and glowing green eyes, plus a spectral aura. Or a pale ghost cat. The current CSS applies glow. I'll draw a seated cat silhouette with pointy ears, tail, whiskers, glowing eyes, a little collar with star/moon tag. Use purples/blues.

Let me design a cat SVG viewBox 0 0 220 210.

Elements:
- shadow ellipse at bottom
- tail: curved path behind, animating with .tail class (transform-origin at base).
- body: seated cat shape, haunch, chest, front legs/paws.
- head: rounded with pointed ears, inner ears, eyes glowing, nose, mouth, whiskers.
- collar with moon charm.
- maybe a ghostly wisp at base.
- Keep classes `.tail`, `.head`, `.eyes` for animations.
- Colors: body #3a2b4a (dark plum) with rim highlights #6a5a78; chest #4a3a58; ears inner #8f6fa6; eyes #8fe6c8 glow; nose #d98aa8; whiskers #9a8fa8. Add spectral outline.
- Since scene background is dark purple, a dark cat with rim light works. Add an ectoplasm glow via CSS filter and maybe a pale aura.

Alternatively, a white ghost cat would pop more. But "ghost cat" could be pale translucent blue. The gothic theme already has ghost dog concept. Let's make a spectral pale cat (like a spirit) with dark inner ears and glowing green eyes. That reads clearly on dark scene. Body #cfdfe4 with subtle lavender shadows #a9bccb, chest #eaf6f6. Tail wispy with fade. Add slight transparency (opacity .95). Good.

## Objective
- Finish the existing incremental cooking game as a complete, playable game.
- Apply the user’s requested gothic spooky style while preserving the game mechanics.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots at a viewport no wider than 1280px; read only the latest screenshot, and use full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
- User asked: “Can I ask for it to be a gothic spooky style”

## Decisions
- Re-theme the late-night diner into a gothic “Graveyard Grill,” with spooky copy and palette while keeping the incremental gameplay intact.
- Use a locally saved Pirata One font for the gothic display styling.

## Work State

input.newString:
Gravekeeper handbook

Run the midnight shift.

The Graveyard Grill is open until dawn. The regulars are restless, the hellfire is hot, and Nugget is technically the manager.

01
Cook the cursed patties

Tap the burger or press Space. Every tap fills the oldest ticket. Upgrades add haunted auto-grill output.

02
Cash the souls

When a ticket fills, it pays out automatically. Keep the queue moving before the dead get impatient.

03
Stoke the hellfire

Fast tapping heats the meter and multiplies every ticket payout. It cools down when you stop.

04
Send in the ghost cat

Tap Nugget or press Z for Zoomies: double output for a short burst. Spirit treats make it last longer and hit harder.

★

Unlock upgrades as you serve more souls, then raise a new crypt to reset the shift with a permanent bonus. Achievements stick around forever.

Now update game.js copy. Many edits.

- UPGRADES names/descs/effect "tips" -> "souls" maybe. Keep "tips" mechanic but theme: "souls". Change effect "+22% tips" -> "+22% souls". Unlock "Serve 1" -> "Feed 1", etc. Buy cost uses cash. Fine.
- DISHES/CUSTOMERS.
- Achievements.
- LOCATION_NAMES.
- Zoomies bubble "BORK!" -> "MEOW!".
- toast "Nugget is catching a breath" -> "Nugget is fading out".
- "Nugget doubles output" fine.
- no-tickets copy.
- First ticket served copy "Tips are in. Upgrade the kitchen..." -> "Souls are in. Upgrade the crypt..."
- heat hints: "On fire · maximum tip bonus" -> "Inferno · maximum soul bonus"; "Keep it hot for bigger tips" -> "Keep the hellfire high"; "Tap fast to boost order tips" -> "Tap fast to stoke the hellfire".
- title FRYDAY keep brand.
- franchise descriptions.
- sideSub.
- toast Not enough tips -> "Not enough souls".
- doFranchise "New FRYDAY opened!" -> "New crypt raised!".
- reset "Fresh kitchen" -> "Fresh crypt"; "same good dog" -> "same ghost cat".
- Welcome back "Nugget kept the grill warm" -> "Nugget kept the hellfire burning".
- orders empty "Next regular walking in…" -> "Next soul drifting in…".
- maybe "Serve 1" etc.
- Achievement "Good Dog" -> "Good Familiar"; desc.
- "First Flip" -> "First Flip" okay. "Hot Stuff" -> "Hellfire". "Pocket Money" -> "Grave Money"? Keep some.
- "Franchise Owner" -> "Crypt Owner"; desc "Open your first franchise." -> "Raise your first crypt."; id stays franchise.
- "Future Empire" fine.

Let's edit blocks.
Now the game text and content data.

- Complete the incremental cooking game as a playable gothic spooky game.
- Make the pet a cat.

- Preserve the game mechanics and existing save compatibility.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

- (none)

- (none)

1. (none)

- `index.html`: Game markup, SVG scene and ghost-cat artwork, interface text.
- `styles.css`: Gothic palette, layout, and styling.
- `game.js`: Game logic and themed gameplay copy.
- `assets/fonts/pirata-one.woff2`: Bundled gothic display font.
- `screenshots/`: Latest desktop, mobile, and help JPEG captures.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing saves and game mechanics were left intact.
- Visual checks were performed programmatically; screenshots could not be visually rendered in the session.
